# AI-Excision Patch Set — apply guide

**What these are.** Verifiable unified diffs of the complete AI excision + adjacent work, generated by
`../generate_ai_patches.py` as `git diff` between the **vanilla vault**
(`Firefox.Scripts.Vault.Docs/SafetyVault.Firefox/firefox-main`) and the **live excised tree**
(`/home/gorilla/firefox-main`).

**Verification guarantee.** The generator does not just emit these — it *proves* them: each patch is
applied to a fresh copy of the vanilla files and the result is diffed against the live tree. All 8
patches report **OK / "reproduce the live tree from vanilla."** Re-run `generate_ai_patches.py` any
time to re-verify.

**Scope.** 102 modified/deleted files (the operator's own count) + 452 files in dirs removed wholesale
(listed, not content-diffed, in the manifest). Everything since AI-excision began: the AI Window,
genai, ml, llama.cpp/mozinference, smart tab grouping, LinkPreview, the recommendations/AI surfaces,
plus adjacent fixes found during GUI testing (the phantom-customize CSS bug, tab-groups-off).

## Apply

```bash
cd /path/to/vanilla/firefox-main        # a clean FF154 tree matching the vault base
for p in 01-native-unwire 02-window-chrome-seams 03-module-seams 04-genai-translations \
         05-ftl-l10n-markup 06-tabgroups-customize-adjacent 07-prefs-firefox-js-FULL \
         08-deleted-files ; do
  git apply -p1 <THIS_DIR>/ai-excision-$p.patch || { echo "STOP at $p"; break; }
done
# then delete the dirs listed in ai-excision-09-removed-dirs-MANIFEST.txt (or move them aside)
# then build (see the build atoms; mach build faster hangs — config.status + make -C obj/faster)
```

**If a patch fails to apply**, the base tree is not the vault base (drift). The scripts in `..` are the
assert-once alternative that fails loud on drift rather than fuzzing. Full narrative:
`../../SESSION_CHRONICLE_2026-07-31_to_08-03.md`; per-edit reasoning: `../EXCISION_MANIFEST.md`;
verification method + design: `../README_SCRIPTS.md`.
